text.p: Italian bond futures started firmer buoyed by the early strength of German bunds which had in turn been reassured by the late rally last night in T-bonds in the U.S., dealers said.
They added that U.S. bonds had fallened on strong manufacturing data yesterday, but a late rally helped the market there to close overnight with only small losses.
"The underlying picture for Italy is still positive, and the the U.S. overnight close helped give us some early support for BTPs," said one LIFFE trader.
